scope: Round 11. User request (2026-10-28): 'modify the header for customer: search bar at center, left first 3 navlinks, right 3 last'. Builds on round 10 (archived as progress-feature-list/feature_list_10.json). Layout only; links, routes, search behaviour and every business rule from rounds 1-10 stay. Extended (2026-10-28): "modify header to all role required, keep them same as customer, but with admin and staff the navlink on right side change to role based dashboard" -> hdr-1.2. Extended (2026-10-28): "reside header to fit with height of body" -> hdr-1.3 (read as: header content width matches the body column).

source_requirements.text: let's modify the header for customer search bar at center, left first 3 navlinks, righ 3 last

readings_to_confirm: The six customer links keep their order: Browse, Dashboard, Bids go left of the search; Credit, My goods, My Auctions go right of it, before the bid limit and avatar.
'Center' = the search sits between the two link groups, which share the free space equally; it is not pinned to the exact page midpoint (brand and user box differ in width).
Guest, staff and admin bars are unchanged. On screens up to 900px the existing folding menu stays (all six links in one column, search on its own row).
hdr-1.2: staff and admin get the same bar shape as customers: brand | left links | search | right links | role pill + avatar.

hdr-1.2: left group for staff/admin = Browse only (Dashboard and Bids are customer pages); right group = their role pages (Statistics, Manage auctions, Goods, Credit management, Users, Permissions), each still shown only with its permission.
hdr-1.2: staff and admin now also get the top search (it opens Browse, which they can already view). Guests are unchanged.

hdr-1.3: "fit with height of body" read as WIDTH: the header background stays full-width, its content lines up with the 1240px body column (brand on the left content edge, avatar / auth buttons on the right). Consequence: staff/admin search always takes its own centred row on desktop, since 5 role links + a usable search do not fit in 1208px.

The search centre lies within the middle third of the bar.
Nothing overlaps and the bar does not scroll sideways from 901px up.
At 900px and below the folding menu still holds all six links and the search keeps its own row.
Guest and staff bars keep their current layout.
